summary: Operator site + its reservation form: 6 full-hookup (30/50 A) pull-through sites, free WiFi, $36/night plus tax ($216/week, $600/month), self-contained rigs only (no restrooms). Google 4.8 (31). Passes the price gate; not waterfront kept. Nightly share not measurable (no site inventory); the site markets overnight and short stays, the rental agreement is written as a residential lease.
flags: LONG-STAY CHECK (not a drop candidate on the evidence): posted nightly rate $36 alongside $216/week and $600/month; the site markets 'whether you're staying overnight or a few days' and 'perfect stop for road-trippers, rodeo fans, hunters'; one testimonial is a summer long-term stay. The agreement every booker signs reads 'to be used and occupied by Lessee as a residence' - boilerplate on the same form as the nightly rate. Nightly share unmeasured (6 sites, no availability view). Google Maps 'Lusk RV Park - Lone Pine Campground LLC': 4.8 stars, 31 reviews.
PRICE GATE: $36/night plus tax - passes; no gateway check needed.
